title: Resolve remaps moved lines and reports changed lines stale
preconditions: A Git repository with app.go committed at a pin, and a reference authored to lines 3-4 at that pin.

steps.action: Resolve the reference at the pin.
Commit a change only under a .saga path and resolve there.
steps.expected_result: Current at the same lines; nothing moves.

steps.action: Insert two lines above the range and resolve.
Rename app.go to main.go with the same content and resolve.
Change a referenced line and resolve.
steps.expected_result: Stale with the reason naming lines 3-4 of app.go, and DiffSince shows the change.

steps.action: Resolve a reference whose digest does not match at its own pin.

expected_result: Moved and renamed lines stay current, Saga-only commits move nothing, and changed or tampered references are stale.
